interpretation: Recognition quality of a frozen-embedding head against hashed-token references on labelled corpora. The 35% / 20% training subsets, the fixed valence map and the proxy nature of support are declared in config.json. Nothing here measures benefit to users; sensor outputs are machine interpretations that fill affect evidence only and never establish facts, authority or permissions.
